title: Declare the fake contract on hermetic acceptances that use fakes

facts.note: Acceptance documents are identifiable by file kind/path.
Requires a field-level parser of the acceptance to read execution_kind.
Requires a field-level parser of the acceptance to read permitted_fakes; empty list means the rule does not fire.

fires: An acceptance has execution_kind: hermetic_integration and permitted_fakes lists one or more fakes/cassettes.
A fake/cassette is added to permitted_fakes of a hermetic_integration acceptance that previously had none.
doesNotFire: Acceptance with execution_kind: hermetic_integration and an empty permitted_fakes list (fidelity rule does not apply).
Acceptance whose execution_kind is not hermetic_integration (e.g. live_smoke).

given: An acceptance with execution_kind: hermetic_integration and non-empty permitted_fakes
when: the acceptance exists or is written
then: Declare the full hermetic fake-contract block — exercised_boundaries, permitted_fakes, one fake_contract_fidelity entry {name, fidelity, known_gaps} per permitted fake, and live_smoke_required; the declaration IS the contract.
prefer: exercised_boundaries uses only boundary_kind vocabulary values for surfaces actually exercised.
Each permitted fake gets exactly one fake_contract_fidelity entry with matching name, fidelity and a known_gaps list.
live_smoke_required: true when a paired execution_kind: live_smoke sibling must exist under the same WMBT; optionally add live_smoke_reason.
avoid: A permitted fake without a fidelity entry, or an entry missing name, fidelity or known_gaps.
unless: permitted_fakes is empty — the fidelity rule does not apply.
why: The declaration IS the contract: for each fake substituted for live infra it records name, fidelity and known gaps.
evidence: For every name in permitted_fakes there is exactly one fake_contract_fidelity entry with name, fidelity and known_gaps (list[str], present).
exercised_boundaries and live_smoke_required are present; when live_smoke_required is true a live_smoke sibling exists under the same WMBT.
verifier_detail: Field types: exercised_boundaries: list[boundary_kind] (required, controlled vocab — free-text boundary names are not allowed); permitted_fakes: list[str] — named fakes/cassettes substituted for live infra (may be empty; when empty the fidelity rule does not apply); fake_contract_fidelity: list of {name, fidelity, known_gaps: list[str] required}, one per permitted fake (required when permitted_fakes non-empty); live_smoke_required: bool (required); live_smoke_reason: str (optional, when live_smoke_required is true).
Term fake_contract: the declared fidelity contract for each permitted fake: name, fidelity, and required known_gaps.

splitSuggestion.then: When live_smoke_required is true, ensure a paired execution_kind: live_smoke acceptance exists under the same WMBT.

additions.text: The paired live_smoke sibling existence (S013) is an independent obligation across acceptances; suggest a separate convention planner.acceptance.live-smoke-sibling. Here it is kept as part of the block declaration and as evidence.

additions.justification: Required by schema; derived directly from the two source trigger conditions (S006/S009/S011), with no phase or actor prerequisite.
